subject.title: fix: guard JSON.parse calls against malformed external responses

question: How should maintainers coordinate this PR's OpenRouter JSON guard with the open OpenRouter memory-cap branch at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101488?
rationale: Both branches touch the same parser function and address different safety issues, so automation should not decide the landing order or whether to fold one OpenRouter hunk into the other.

options.title: Coordinate Both Branches
options.body: Land or rebase the branches so this PR's malformed-frame guard and the memory-cap PR's byte limits coexist in the final OpenRouter parser.

options.title: Fold OpenRouter Into The Memory-Cap Branch
options.body: Ask contributors to move the malformed-frame guard into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101488 and keep this PR only for docs search and Claude MCP config.

options.title: Land This PR First
options.body: Accept this broader parse-hardening PR first and require the memory-cap branch to rebase around the caught JSON.parse path afterward.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Both Branches
recommendation.body: Land or rebase the branches so this PR's malformed-frame guard and the memory-cap PR's byte limits coexist in the final OpenRouter parser.
